cases.purpose: Report the actual affinity after a mixed available and unavailable CPU request.
cases.oracle: Independent /proc/PID/status Cpus_allowed_list after sched_setaffinity; current guest has exactly two CPUs.
cases.comparison: Reported new list and procfs both equal CPU 0; no request or prerequisite is normalized.
cases.script:
[[ $(</sys/devices/system/cpu/online) == 0-1 ]] || exit 125
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import os; assert 0 in os.sched_getaffinity(0)' || exit 125
/usr/bin/sleep 30 & child=$!
trap 'kill "$child" 2>/dev/null; wait "$child" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
out=$(taskset -cp 0,1023 "$child") || exit 1
[[ $out == *"pid $child's new affinity list: 0" ]] || { printf 'unexpected output: %s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/python3 - "$child" <<'PY_CHECK'
import pathlib,sys
lines=pathlib.Path('/proc/'+sys.argv[1]+'/status').read_text().splitlines()
line=next(x for x in lines if x.startswith('Cpus_allowed_list:'))
assert line.split(':',1)[1].strip() == '0', line
PY_CHECK
printf 'effective affinity agrees with reported list\n'
cases.stdout: effective affinity agrees with reported list
